sampling: Deterministic full Cartesian grids in listed order; no random draws or Monte Carlo
exposure: Existing public development specifications only; no reserved cases, labels, reviewer or policy tuning
pilot: First two grid entries per swept model plus its nominal case; measure before full grid. Full run only if projected runtime and size fit caps.
stopping: Keep every grid entry and diagnostic, including failures. Exact-route mismatch stops dependent fault work for that model; cylinder budget failure excludes that specification from downstream use. No tolerance retuning. Stop at resource cap with next-index checkpoint; no baselines without admission.

cantilever_uniform_load.qualification: All inherited partitions must give exact claim equality and equilibrium. Units, clamp/free-end and dead-load assumptions inherited unchanged.

vm25_pressure_only.qualification: Preserve PR21 gate: all inherited 32/64/128-step claim errors within 1e-6 characteristic-scale budget. Extra 256/512 steps diagnose failure without rescuing eligibility. Keep traction and separate trapezoid equilibrium residuals. No end resultant, sigma_z=0, free axial strain.

vm92_layered_wall.qualification: All inherited layer partitions must give exact claim equality and local heat balance. Perfect contact and linear steady convection/conduction retained; no radiation or physical furnace prediction.

reused: axial family and all historical outputs
slab Dirichlet qualification as supporting conduction control

faults.eligibility: Nominal specification and each changed artifact must independently meet inherited numerical qualification; exact-route sweep failure blocks that model. Numerical eligibility is provisional, never human admission.
faults.scale: Absolute nominal observable, except outer wall temperature uses nominal temperature minus ambient in delta_degF. Positive scales required. These are synthetic agreement tolerances, separate from inherited numerical qualification.
faults.reference_error: Exact rational truth has zero arithmetic error; exact assembly uses rational output without serialization. Cylinder observation uncertainty additionally includes the inherited 1e-6 characteristic-scale numerical budget for the changed artifact, verified against exact truth at each evaluated magnitude.
faults.decision: Inclusive pass at abs(observed - nominal) <= tolerance. With exact signal d and total bounded error e: guaranteed pass when d+e<=t, guaranteed detection when d-e>t, otherwise error-dependent. No probabilities or empirical reviewer sensitivity.

boundary_search.method: Monotone deterministic interval bisection for leaving guaranteed pass and entering guaranteed detection; preserve brackets and strictness. No crossing is reported explicitly.

faults.controls: Correct magnitude zero; benign partition or radial refinement; nuisance metadata changes density/heat capacity only in models excluding them. Null space is derived from governing equations and checked by exact response differences, never assigned from a mutation name.

fea: Offline retained-record inspection only. Check same geometry/material/load, target h, observable, refinement changes and asymptotic behavior. Never infer effective h from element counts or combine conflicting local/global refinements. Report unavailable p/extrapolation/GCI if eligibility fails.

excluded.holed_plate: Retained finite plate has geometry and load but no qualified exact reference or feasible authorized independent finite-domain solve. Heywood correlation and infinite Kirsch cannot supply one; VM142 is a different specified problem.
excluded.baselines: Labels, applicable-check matrix, independent truth admission and human review remain incomplete; no policy execution or M1.2/M2 completion.
